fields.statement: At 8a20d26a I built rhiza into a scratch dir with -X main.version=qa-v1, ran `rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual` in a fresh scratch repo (pid 4031), then rebuilt the same path in place as qa-v2. Within one 5s poll stderr printed 'binary changed, re-executing' and 'daemon running, process ...:4031': same pid, argv unchanged (ps shows `rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual`), and daemon status then showed Version: qa-v2. Over the next polls it did not re-exec again. Moving the binary away for two polls (as mid-rebuild) and back with the same mtime caused no exec. After the re-exec a second `rhiza daemon --once` was refused with exit 2 ('another daemon holds the lock: process ...:4031'), so the new image holds the lock. SIGINT then stopped it cleanly ('Daemon ...:4031 stopped'). The pending-start delay and live runs carrying on were not exercised by hand (empty model, no runs); go test ./internal/daemon ./internal/api pass.

At 8a20d26a, with a binary built with -X main.version=qa-v1 running `rhiza daemon` in a scratch repo, `rhiza daemon status` printed 'Version: qa-v1' and --json carried "version": "qa-v1". After rebuilding in place as qa-v2 and the daemon re-executing, status printed 'Version: qa-v2'. After SIGINT, status printed 'Daemon not running', 'Last daemon: ... stopped ...' and still 'Version: qa-v2'. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-status|describe-golden)$' passes.
